name: aiagentslisting
description: Find and compare MCP servers, AI agents and skills from the AI Agents Listing directory, with alternatives and trending lists.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. The read tools need no account or API key; submitting a listing or review uses OAuth.

npm.description: Local stdio bridge to the hosted endpoint.

examples.title: Find a server
examples.prompt: Find MCP servers for Postgres and compare the top two.

examples.title: See what is trending
examples.prompt: What AI agents are trending this week?

examples.title: Find alternatives
examples.prompt: Show alternatives to Cursor in the AI agents listing.
